sections.Intro: This remedy is indicated in cases of respiratory and digestive disorders. It is useful in cases of chronic catarrh and chronic inflammation of the mucous membranes. There is a general feeling of weakness and debility. It is also useful in cases of skin diseases.
sections.Head: Headache, with a sensation of weight in the forehead. Vertigo.
sections.Nose: Chronic catarrh of the nose. Dryness and obstruction. Sneezing.
sections.Stomach: Appetite poor. Nausea. Heaviness and pressure after eating.
sections.Abdomen: Distended with gas. Flatulence. Chronic constipation.
sections.Respiratory: Shortness of breath on motion. Violent cough, ending in sneezing. Hoarseness.
sections.Skin: Dry and scaly. Itching and burning.
